items.description:
The German Development Cooperation (GIZ) South Africa office has coordinated German-South African development projects since the country office opened in Pretoria in 1996. Its work is organised around three priority areas: supporting peaceful and inclusive societies, promoting sustainable economic development and skills training, and advancing the climate and energy transition.

Within the energy and climate priority, the Pretoria office hosts the Secretariat of the Energy Partnership, giving it a coordinating role in one of the country's bilateral energy cooperation structures. As the implementing arm of German development cooperation in South Africa, the office works with government departments, municipalities and other partners to turn donor-funded programmes into projects on the ground, rather than only providing funding from abroad.

JAPS Printing is a family-owned and operated printing business in Elardus Park, Pretoria, offering wide-format printing of vinyl stickers, banners, canvas prints and signage alongside full-colour printing of business cards, flyers and posters. The business also provides personalised design and print work for small businesses and event planners.

For parties and milestone events such as birthdays, baby showers, graduations and cultural gatherings, JAPS helps with both design and print, producing custom banners, themed stickers, table accents and signage in flexible finishes and culturally inspired themes. Customers unsure where to start are guided from mood boards through to mockups, and the business is open on weekdays from 8:30am to 5pm for orders and consultations.

JLF Automotive is a mobile mechanic service based in Klerksoord, Akasia, bringing automotive repairs and maintenance directly to the customer's home, office or roadside location rather than requiring a trip to a workshop. Its technicians cover engine diagnostics and repair, brake servicing, battery replacement and jump starts, oil and filter changes, tyre services, suspension and steering work, clutch and gearbox repairs, and cooling system maintenance.

The business reports particular experience with Jaguar, Land Rover and Ford vehicles alongside other makes and models, and serves the wider Pretoria metropolitan area, including Centurion, Midrand, Pretoria East, Pretoria North, Pretoria West and surrounding suburbs. JLF Automotive offers 24/7 emergency availability and provides upfront quotes before starting work, aiming for transparent pricing without hidden costs.

Maltech-Africa Business Consultancy & Advisory Services is a registered Trusts and Companies Service Provider operating as a Zimbabwe-South Africa compliance and trade facilitation hub from Claudius, Pretoria. It supports entrepreneurs, diaspora investors and community institutions through corporate services, diaspora relocation support, rural development initiatives and digital empowerment programmes.

Its compliance work covers company registration, BEE certification, COIDA and letters of good standing, UIF, PAYE and SDL administration, and CIPC annual returns, alongside more specialised services such as non-resident business setup, work permits, SADC compliance, import and export customs document certification, and trademark registration. The firm describes its role as staying involved with clients from initial registration through day-to-day operation, rather than handing over paperwork and stepping back.

Midstream College is a parallel-medium private school, teaching in either Afrikaans or English, with a Christian ethos situated inside the secure Midstream Estate south of Centurion. Its high school opened in 2007, and its first grade 12 class wrote the IEB final exams in 2009, building a track record the school describes in terms of high academic standards, quality teaching and firm discipline.

The campus includes a large auditorium, an indoor swimming pool and hockey astroturf, and the school runs an annual exchange programme to Belgium alongside adventure club trips that have included summiting Mont-aux-Sources, kloofing in the Magaliesberg, river rafting on the Orange River and diving at Sodwana Bay. Its Grade 10 Odyssey, a nine-day challenge, is a fixture of the school's calendar, built around its motto, Excellentia.

Minit Print Centurion is part of a printing franchise group established in 1971, trading from the Byls Bridge Promenade Centre in Highveld, Centurion. The branch offers a choice of lithographic printing for large-volume runs and digital printing for smaller, quick-turnaround jobs, backed by an in-house design department that produces business cards, flyers, brochures, posters, company profiles and catalogues.

Estimates are prepared after a verbal or email discussion and typically returned within a few hours, and the franchise says it aims to build long-lasting relationships with customers rather than treat printing as a one-off transaction. Minit Print Centurion is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm and Saturdays from 9am to 11am.

Modic, trading as Modic Creative Digital Agency, is a Centurion-based digital marketing agency formed in 2022 from the merger of McCrea Media and ModuTech. It offers SEO, Google Ads management, social media marketing, video and animation production, design, branding and web and software development.

The agency works with clients across South Africa as well as in the United States and Ireland, giving it an international client base alongside its local Centurion work. That combination of a broad service range, spanning everything from paid search campaigns to branded video production, lets Modic act as a single marketing partner for clients who would otherwise need to coordinate separate agencies for design, advertising and video work.

NIFDAR Consulting SA is a global public health strategic and management consulting firm based in Woodhill Golf Estate, Pretoria, helping clients deliver projects on HIV/AIDS, TB, COVID-19, malaria and other infectious and non-communicable diseases across Africa. Its service range covers proposal writing, monitoring, evaluation and learning, and clinical epidemiology consulting for public health organisations.

More recently, NIFDAR has expanded into climate health and climate change services, global health security work, and artificial intelligence and AI readiness assessments for the health sector, alongside digital health and social impact consulting. It also runs public health training and capacity-building programmes, and has an affiliated public benefit organisation focused on improving health access for underserved communities.

Play Town is an indoor pretend-play and party venue in Hennopspark, Centurion, built around ten themed playrooms linked by a decorated roadway track for bike riding. Its attractions include a pirate-ship-shaped jungle gym with slides and an obstacle course, a rock-climbing wall, and around 250 square metres of trampolines split by age group.

An outdoor area adds a tent, additional rock-climbing elements and gender-specific treehouses, extending the venue's imaginative play options beyond the indoor playrooms, and an on-site kid-friendly restaurant lets parents get a meal without leaving the venue. Play Town hosts children's parties and school outings, giving schools and families a single venue for both supervised play and catering during a visit.

Pretoria Arms is a firearms and outdoor-gear retailer at Montana Boulevard Lifestyle Centre in Magalieskruin, trading since 1974 and originally a gunsmithing operation specialising in competition-pistol accurizing. It now stocks firearms, ammunition and optics, alongside magazines and accessories for brands including Glock, Beretta, CZ and Tikka.

The store runs an underground shooting range with 25m, 50m and 100m lanes, giving customers a facility to test firearms and practise alongside its retail offering, and it also provides firearm competency training for customers working toward their licence. Both an online store and the physical Magalieskruin branch let customers browse and buy firearms and accessories, with the shooting range remaining the standout feature that sets this branch apart from a standard gun shop.

Python System Design was established in 1991, originally carrying out hardware and software development for the defence industry before shifting into outsourced corporate IT services. The company now provides those services nationally from its Centurion and Cape Town offices.

Its current offering covers backup, cloud computing, cyber security, hardware supply, internet services, software development, general IT support and VoIP telephony, giving it a broad enough range to act as a client's single outsourced IT department rather than one specialist supplier among several. More than three decades of continuous operation, spanning a shift from defence-industry work to corporate IT services, gives the company a long institutional history behind its current outsourced IT offering.

Q Tyres is a Black-owned company in Klerksoord specialising in tyre sales, rim manufacture and rim repair for the mining and industrial sectors. It supplies new tyres, carries out rim repairs, and manufactures polyurethane wheel units for equipment that needs solid, puncture-free wheels.

The business is backed by owners who together bring more than 135 years of experience in the OTR (off-the-road) tyre and rim industry, a depth of specialist knowledge that is unusual for a single supplier to hold in-house. That combination of tyre sales, rim manufacturing and rim repair under one roof lets mining and industrial customers source and maintain large-format tyres and wheels from a single Klerksoord-based supplier rather than using separate specialists for each service.

Q Tyres (Pty) Ltd is a Black-owned tyre company operating from Klerksoord, Pretoria, focused on tyre sales and rim manufacture and repair for the mining sector. Its offering includes new tyres, rim repair work, and polyurethane wheel units built for equipment that needs solid, puncture-resistant wheels rather than standard pneumatic tyres.

Its owners bring a combined total of more than 135 years in the OTR tyre and rim industry, giving the business a depth of specialist technical knowledge built up over decades rather than a single owner's career. By offering tyre sales alongside rim manufacturing and repair, the company positions itself as a single point of contact for mining operations that would otherwise need separate suppliers for tyres, rims and wheel repairs.

Qabula Holdings is a Pretoria-based sourcing, freight and logistics company established in 2015, with more than 15 years of combined team experience serving clients in the mining, chemical and industrial sectors. It offers freight forwarding, customs clearance, supply chain management, and air, sea and road freight, alongside courier deliveries and IOR and EOR (importer and exporter of record) services.

The company describes its approach as going beyond transport, pairing national scale and disciplined execution with local knowledge to remove silos and lower operational risk across a client's supply chain. Qabula delivers sourcing, trade logistics and distribution services across West, Central and Southern Africa, and its Pretoria office is open Monday to Wednesday from 7am to 5pm.

Quanticost is a quantity surveying and construction cost consultancy operating from Lynnwood Manor, formed in October 1999 through the formalised working association of established quantity surveying practices in Pretoria, Johannesburg and Polokwane. The firm holds BBBEE Level 2 status and focuses on reducing the financial risk of developments while adding value for the various participants in a project.

Its feature projects include the Clairwood Master Plan industrial development in Durban, valued at R5 billion, the R1.4 billion Pick n Pay Inland 2 distribution centre in Eastport, Gauteng, and the R670 million Mall of Thembisa retail development, giving a sense of the scale of projects the firm has worked on. That mix of industrial, retail and distribution projects across several provinces reflects a practice built from merging regional quantity surveying firms into one national team.

Ruiter Gaming & Electronics is a games-console and PC repair specialist in Villieria, established in 2020 on the back of around 15 years of prior technical console-repair experience. The business repairs PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo consoles, gaming PCs and laptops, controllers and graphics cards, alongside general PCB repair work, and also sells consoles, PCs and accessories.

All repairs are carried out on-site rather than outsourced to other technicians, which the business says keeps turnaround faster and prices lower, with most console services completed within 48 hours. Ruiter backs its work with a 3-6 month repair warranty, holds a 4.9 Google rating, and reports having completed more than 7,000 repairs since opening.

items.reason: ADDRESS MISMATCH: the firm's own website states it is based in Paulshof, Sandton, not Clubview, Centurion as listed here. The service facts (bookkeeping, tax compliance, payroll, company secretarial, led by a SAICA-registered accountant) match the current text, but the base-address conflict needs confirming before writing a description tied to this specific office.

items.description:
Super Rafts is a Pretoria-based construction firm established in 2003 that specialises in raft foundation design and construction, having built more than a million square metres of raft foundations across Gauteng and the Western Cape. Its design service covers raft layout plans, reinforcement detailing, NHBRC documentation and council approvals.

For setting out a raft foundation on site, the company employs the services of a professional land surveyor, adding a surveying step most general contractors would otherwise need to arrange separately, and its process also includes engineer inspections to confirm the work meets specification. Super Rafts is open on weekdays from 7:30am to 4pm for new quotes and site visits.

taxichoice. is a specialised intermediary in South Africa's minibus taxi industry, based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, connecting financial institutions, taxi associations and operators. Its processing and verification department checks that a taxi purchase is legitimate, assesses route profitability before finance is approved, and helps facilitate compliant vehicle finance between lenders and operators.

Through Zola Taxi Sales, the business helps make owning a taxi more accessible, while its Taxi Rescue recovery department steps in when an owner misses payments, aiming to protect both the creditor and the taxi owner rather than only the lender's side of the deal. taxichoice. positions itself as a single partner covering verification, route analysis, sales and recovery, and its office is open on weekdays from 8am to 5pm.

The Companies Tribunal is a statutory agency of the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition, established under the Companies Act No. 71 of 2008 and based at the dti Campus in Sunnyside, Pretoria. It resolves company disputes such as directorship and name disputes through adjudication and alternative dispute resolution, with jurisdiction across South Africa.

The Tribunal runs an online Case Management System that lets stakeholders file applications and track their progress without needing to submit paperwork in person, and it publishes its decisions and orders for public reference. Positioning itself around speed and cost-effectiveness rather than a full court process, the Tribunal offers companies and directors an alternative route to resolving disputes that would otherwise need to go through the ordinary courts.

Universal Coolers is a heat-exchange and cooling-systems specialist in Raslouw, Centurion, founded in 1999 to supply small to medium-sized aluminium heat exchangers to the market. The business initially focused mainly on oil coolers before expanding its range as it grew, and it now manufactures engine and transmission oil coolers, intercoolers, charge-air coolers and aluminium header tanks.

Its product range also covers air-blast cooling packs in 12V, 24V and higher AC voltages, integrated cooling units combining a radiator, intercooler and transmission oil cooler for military and earthmoving applications, and fan blades, clutches and electric fans and pumps for transport use. Universal Coolers offers intercooler and radiator re-coring and testing plus custom 3D CAD-designed cooling solutions for the motorsport, mining, aviation and earthmoving sectors.

Africa Disability Alliance is a Pretoria-based non-profit organisation established in 2003, advancing the rights, inclusion and empowerment of persons with disabilities across Africa through advocacy and capacity-building. Over more than two decades, it has placed disability at the centre of planning, implementation and evaluation processes at national, African continental and international levels.

Its work has helped shape policy within the African Union and its Regional Economic Communities, as well as contributing to instruments including the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and the African Union's Africa Disability Protocol. The organisation builds its approach around inclusive development and disability human rights, aiming to improve not just individual circumstances but the wider environments people with disabilities interact with.

BJK Industries is a Silvertondale-based producer and distributor of animal proteins, animal fats, oils, minerals and frozen meat by-products for the pet food, livestock feed and aqua feed industries. Its product range also extends into pharmaceutical ingredients and fertiliser raw materials, broadening its customer base beyond animal feed manufacturers alone.

The business operates a 600-ton cold store and two warehouses totalling 1,500 square metres at its Silvertondale site, backed by its own BJK Transport fleet for distribution into the northern parts of the country. That combination of large-scale cold storage and an in-house transport fleet lets BJK commit to delivering ingredients directly to a factory door in full and on time, and its office is open on weekdays from 8am to 5:30pm.

Bravura Group is an accounting, tax and legal services firm based in Kameeldrift East, Pretoria, serving individuals and businesses across Pretoria and Centurion. Its accounting offering covers monthly accounting, VAT and tax returns, and payroll administration including PAYE, UIF and SDL, alongside COIDA registration and compliance.

On the legal and HR side, the firm assists with labour law matters, deeds and trust setup, and retirement and insurance planning, giving clients access to accounting, tax, legal and HR support from one practice rather than separate accountants and attorneys. That combined accounting-and-legal offering is aimed at small and medium businesses that would otherwise need to manage several professional service providers separately.

Buzaphi Construction is a Monument Park-based civil engineering and building contractor, built around a mission of empowering people and developing communities through its construction work. Its civil engineering projects cover road and stormwater work, sewer and water reticulation, road construction, and wastewater treatment plant construction.

The company also builds schools and social development centres alongside general buildings, and runs a plant hire division covering TLBs, tipper trucks and excavators for its own projects and for hire to others. Buzaphi's clients include the City of Tshwane and the Department of Water and Sanitation, and its office is open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm.

Calmex Mobile is an ICASA-licensed digital infrastructure operator based in Doringkloof, Centurion, holding further industry certifications including ISPA, ASN, PASA and AFRINIC registration. It brings together three pillars under one ecosystem: connectivity through telecommunications infrastructure, payments through merchant acquiring and SoftPOS, and mobility through transport and fleet management.

Its consumer-facing Super App connects users, operators and businesses on a single platform for moving, paying, connecting and shopping, while its infrastructure serves public transport operators, government and municipalities, large enterprises, retail and the informal economy, and events and venues. Calmex maintains an active infrastructure presence across Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo and the Eastern Cape, giving it a national rather than purely local footprint.

Car Service City - Wonderboom is a branch of the Car Service City vehicle repair chain, based at Wonderboom Carvenience Shopping Centre and run by the same owner since 2013. The branch offers major and minor servicing and repairs on all makes and models, backed by a 62-point safety check carried out on every vehicle that comes through its doors.

Being part of a national chain gives the branch access to group-wide guarantees and payment options, including fixed-term 'fix now, pay later' plans and instant EFT, while the branch's own long-standing ownership since 2013 gives it more than a decade of continuity in a single location. The branch is open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm.

Citton Cars Menlyn is a used-vehicle dealership with more than 30 years of experience buying and selling pre-owned cars, operating as one of the group's two Gauteng locations alongside its Gezina branch. Every vehicle sold undergoes an independent Bosch 160-point inspection and comes with a 2-month or 3,000km warranty, whichever comes first.

Beyond the sale itself, the Menlyn dealership offers vehicle financing, including options aimed at graduates, trade-in evaluations, car insurance and on-site Bosch Car Service for after-sales maintenance. That combination of an independent mechanical inspection, a short warranty period and on-site servicing is aimed at giving used-car buyers more confidence than a private sale would typically offer.

Cresco Project Finance is a financial advisory firm based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, with further offices in Mauritius and Portugal, working across the energy, infrastructure, mining, health and real estate sectors in Africa. Its services cover transaction advisory, project finance advisory and financial modelling for projects moving from early-stage planning toward financial close.

The firm also offers export credit agency and CPRI advisory, programme management office support, and decarbonisation and energy strategy services, reflecting a focus on the kind of complex, capital-intensive projects that need specialist financial structuring. Cresco works with both project promoters and project funders, aiming to match financial and entrepreneurial goals on both sides of a transaction.

items.reason: Only global DHI Group / MIKE software content was found (international case studies in Singapore and India, the group's water-cycle mission); nothing about this Pretoria office's own staff, local projects or specific South African work. The current text already flags that this is mainly a brand/product description, so it would be entirely group-level.

items.description:
J R Kopano Engineering is a manufacturing engineering firm in Rosslyn that has operated for around 25 years, producing press tools, jigs and fixtures for industrial clients. It also manufactures tooling used in aluminium extrusion, scaffolding, glass and security fencing production.

Beyond tooling for other manufacturers, the business makes its own stainless steel products, including espetada stands supplied to the hospitality industry, extending its work from behind-the-scenes industrial tooling into finished products used directly by restaurants and caterers. That mix of press-tool manufacturing for industrial clients and stainless steel product manufacturing for hospitality gives the Rosslyn business two distinct customer bases built on the same metalworking skills.

Maizey Plastics is the largest independently owned supplier of semi-finished thermoplastic materials in Southern Africa, distributing from this Jan Niemand Park branch as part of a company founded in 1950. Its product range covers engineering, industrial and commercial plastics, signage materials, digital print media, aluminium profiles and heat transfer films.

Specific signage products include aluminium lightbox and LED profiles, aluminium channel letter systems, and Cosign modular signage systems for totems, pylons and illuminated textile displays, alongside POP and POS display systems for retail branding. Maizey distributes through a national network covering South Africa's main economic regions and exports to several neighbouring Southern African states, with a daily delivery and cutting service, and this branch trades weekdays from 8am to 5pm.

Maxi Factory has manufactured bricks at its Klerksoord plant north of Pretoria since 2004, growing from a single plant into a leading maxi brick and cement stock producer with an output of around 160,000 cement stocks and 80,000 maxi bricks per day. Every batch is tested for dimensional accuracy, strength and consistent colour before being released for delivery.

All products are manufactured to SANS 1215 and SANS 1058 specifications, and the company uses its own transport fleet to ship bricks, able to deliver up to 120,000 bricks within 48 hours of an order being placed and payment confirmed. That combination of in-house quality testing and its own delivery fleet lets Maxi Factory commit to consistent product quality and fast turnaround for builders working to a schedule.

Meat 2 Oceans Market is a butchery and fish market inside the secure Tshwane Fresh Produce Market in Marabastad, Pretoria, and describes itself as Gauteng's largest fresh fish market and butchery. The family-run business was founded a decade ago by two brothers-in-law bringing more than twenty years of industry experience between them.

Its customer base includes small business owners, chefs and members of the public who return regularly for its range of fresh and frozen fish alongside butchery products, drawn by what the business positions as affordable, high-quality stock. Operating from inside a secure produce market rather than a standalone shopfront gives the business a built-in base of market traffic alongside its own direct following of repeat customers.

Mediro ICT is an enterprise technology partner based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, specialising in application performance monitoring, enterprise service management, digital employee experience and automated software testing for banks, financial services firms and other large organisations across South Africa and the wider Sub-Saharan region. It also offers business intelligence, infrastructure and unified security services.

The company builds its six service pillars on OEM partnerships with Dynatrace for observability, ServiceNow for service management, Tricentis for quality and testing, and BMC Control-M for enterprise automation, rather than generic in-house tooling. Mediro ICT holds B-BBEE status, and its reliance on named, accredited enterprise platforms gives large clients a level of platform-specific expertise that a smaller, more general IT consultancy would struggle to match.

Mindset Mining Consultants is a 51% Black-owned, Level 2 BBBEE mining engineering and consulting firm based in Erasmusrand, specialising in coal mining evaluations. Its geology work covers exploration drilling management, quality analysis, geological modelling and competent person reports, feeding into mine planning, design, development and ventilation design.

On the financial side, the firm carries out capital and operating cost estimation, financial modelling, sensitivity analysis and benchmarking, alongside production and productivity recommendations and safety, health, environment and community management for operating mines. Mindset has completed projects for clients across South Africa and the rest of Africa, as well as in the UK, Russia and the USA, covering the full chain from early-stage investigation through to an investment decision.

Morgan Holdings, based in Brummeria, Pretoria, is a diversified group whose interests span meat, wine and leather alongside logistics. Morgan Beef operates as a leading meat supplier, processor and exporter in Sub-Saharan Africa, while the group's Beyerskloof wine business has been producing red wine in Stellenbosch for more than 30 years and has become one of South Africa's leading Pinotage producers.

The group's leather arm, Brits Leathers, has set a target of a fully deforestation and conversion-free supply chain by 2030, while Morgan Cargo, the group's logistics business, offers sea and air freight forwarding and contract logistics from branches across South Africa. That spread across food production, wine, leather and logistics gives Morgan Holdings a presence in several unrelated supply chains rather than a single core industry.

One 85 in Vinko is a self-catering flatlet with a separate entrance on the owner's Sinoville property, close to the Sefako Makgatho highway, Montana Hospital and schools including Overkruin, Northridge and Stephanus Roos Primary. It sleeps two guests in an open-plan unit with a kitchenette, free WiFi and DStv, and does not accept children.

Check-in runs from 1pm to 6pm and check-out is at 10am, a straightforward arrangement suited to the unit's small size and single-booking setup. The listing holds a perfect 5.0 rating across 23 reviews, with guests consistently rating its location as excellent given its proximity to the highway, hospital and surrounding schools.

PPC Hercules Factory is an integrated cement plant in Hermanstad that traces its roots to 1892, when it began operating as Eerste Fabrieken Zement, making it the first Portland cement manufacturer in Africa. It remains a major cement production site supplying much of the cement used across South Africa.

The factory operates as part of PPC's wider network of 14 cement factories across South Africa, Botswana, the DRC and Zimbabwe, a group with a combined annual capacity of around nine million tonnes of cement products. That combination of a founding history stretching back more than 130 years and continued production within a large regional cement group gives the Hercules plant a long-standing role in supplying South Africa's building industry.

PRBB Trailers - Factory in Donkerhoek manufactures Tautliner, Flatdeck and Side Tipper trailers, having grown from its roots as a trailer manufacturer founded in Piet Retief, Mpumalanga in 1969. The business first established itself in the province's forestry and agriculture sectors largely through word-of-mouth before expanding into a wider range of industries.

Establishing a production line in Pretoria helped PRBB become one of the fastest-growing players in the trailer market, achieving a tenfold increase in production and revenue within six years by optimising production processes, standardising designs across its range and offering greater payload capacity. All PRBB trailers, including its skeletal, dropside, step deck and walking floor models, are now manufactured and delivered from this Pretoria facility, which keeps slightly shorter hours on Fridays than the rest of the week.

Ultimate Powder Coaters is a powder coating, sandblasting and metal fabrication specialist in Koedoespoort with more than 25 years of experience, offering over 4,000 colour options alongside chemical paint stripping. Its pre-treatment process includes degreasing, phosphating and rinsing stages that chemically clean and profile metal before coating, improving corrosion resistance and coating longevity.

Its sandblasting service uses high-pressure abrasive blasting to strip rust, old coatings and contaminants back to a clean SA 2.5 surface profile, with a blast chamber that handles items from small brackets and wheels through to large chassis, roll bars and caravan frames. The business also takes on custom metalwork, welding and fabrication projects, and its Koedoespoort workshop is open Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Fridays from 7:30am to 1:30pm.

Uniqon Developers is a Pretoria property development group established in 1985, building residential estates, including sectional-title apartments, simplex units and townhouses, as well as retail centres. Over nearly four decades, the company has completed a portfolio of more than 7,895 residential units across suburbs including Six Fountains, Olympus, Montana and Brooklyn.

Uniqon says it has worked with the same engineers, architects and construction teams for years, treating those long-standing relationships as central to delivering reliable projects. Alongside residential development, the group develops retail centres across Pretoria and Gauteng, ranging from neighbourhood shopping centres to larger-format retail, giving it a presence in both the residential and commercial property markets.

Waldick Attorneys is a full-service law firm in Clubview formed in 2015 through the merger of Weyer Waldick & Willemse Attorneys and JVR Attorneys. Its corporate and commercial practice covers company liquidation, business rescue, corporate restructuring and the registration of new companies, alongside high court and magistrates' court litigation.

The firm also practises labour law and construction and mining law for business clients, while its private client side covers sequestrations and rehabilitation, family trusts, changes to a matrimonial property system, family law and divorces, wills and estates, and criminal law. That spread across corporate, commercial and private client work lets Waldick serve both business clients navigating financial distress and individuals dealing with family or criminal matters from the same Clubview office.

WWISE, short for World Wide Industrial & Systems Engineers, is a Centurion-based ISO consulting and implementation firm established in 2009, serving clients across 23 countries. Its core services cover ISO certification support, auditing and gap analysis against an organisation's existing systems, products, processes and procedures, plus ongoing monthly ISO maintenance plans to guard against suspension.

Beyond ISO work, WWISE runs training and learnerships in engineering, finance and business, continual-improvement programmes such as Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma, and its own e-learning platform, letting delegates study ISO content remotely. The firm also develops custom video and induction systems covering site safety and company policy, and takes on content development, multimedia design and custom software projects for clients needing more than certification support alone.

Amber Energy is a solar and energy solutions provider based in Irene, Centurion, with more than 25 years of experience designing, building and maintaining solar photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses. Its installations include backup, hybrid, grid-tied and off-grid setups built around Victron and Sunsynk inverters, tailored to each client's budget and power needs.

The company says it integrates systems and technologies developed by its own team of scientists and engineers with the most advanced equipment available, aiming to cut electricity costs and carbon footprint for both residential and business clients. Amber Energy reports completing more than 1,000 successful solar installations, alongside the energy audits it carries out before recommending a system.

Bevonkte Projects SOLAR is a Pretoria North solar and electrical company with more than 17 years of experience, offering turnkey EPC solar installations alongside electrical compliance certificates, SSEG reports and ongoing maintenance. Its installation range runs from 105kW hybrid systems up to 375kW commercial grid-tied plants, as well as farm-based solar systems with battery backup and irrigation control.

The company works extensively with Deye inverters, from 5kW residential units up to 16kW systems, alongside hybrid inverters and battery energy storage solutions for both residential and commercial clients. Bevonkte has also expanded into electric vehicle charging, installing EV charging stations and home EV chargers, and serves clients beyond Gauteng into North West, Limpopo, Mpumalanga and the Free State.

Budget Plants is a nursery on Stellenberg Road in Equestria, Pretoria, originally opened as R3 and R5 Nursery in 1999 before evolving into Budget Plants and Landscaping. It grows much of its own stock and sells flowers, plants, trees, seedlings, herbs, pots and gardening accessories, and hosts occasional gardening workshops covering topics such as gardening for birds without creating a pest problem.

The nursery has built up a loyal following over the years, with more than 12,000 followers on its Facebook page and around 90% of reviewers recommending it. Budget Plants is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 4pm and Saturdays from 9am to 3pm, giving customers a weekend window to shop for plants alongside weekday visits.

Cadcon, trading as Cadcon Steel Construction & Engineering, is a privately owned structural steelwork company established in 1987 on a plot outside Pretoria, now based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion. The firm specialises in structural steelwork solutions across the construction and engineering industries, with a monthly production capacity of around 600 tons.

Cadcon manages projects and structural steelwork using Fabtrol software, with 3D modelling and detail draughting carried out in TEKLA, and its scope covers the supply, fabrication and erection of both structural steelwork and platework, backed by its own blasting and painting facilities. The company is a member of the South African Institute of Steel Construction in good standing, and has worked on projects across South Africa and neighbouring countries over more than three decades.

items.reason: Only chain-level facts (established 2003, generic and compatible printer cartridges for major brands) were available; the store's own page returned only a loading placeholder with no content, and search results were generic chain copy and competitor adverts, with nothing specific to the Elardus Park branch. Per the chain rule, chain-level facts alone aren't enough.

items.description:
CCL Global is a health and sports industry company based in Annlin Business Park, Pretoria, providing products and technology for injury prevention and recovery, and working with South African sports brands including the Springboks, Bulls, Lions and Stormers. The company's name comes from the first letters of its directors' three children's names.

Alongside its product work, CCL Global focuses heavily on developing its own employees, promoting staff on merit rather than time served and providing ongoing training in both management and sales and marketing, in addition to the initial training most employers only give at the start of a job. The business is part of a group with branches in South Africa, Namibia, Taiwan and the United Kingdom, and its Annlin office is open on weekdays from 8am to 5pm.
